facts.fact: Elise 在汗帐外看见被放逐十年的 Alar 回到 Merogian 的土地，惊疑且愤怒
facts.anchor: What was Alar doing back on Merogian soil?

facts.fact: 她把想尖叫的冲动用掌心的梭子戳破，借此稳住胆气与舌头，留在王后身边
facts.anchor: punctured it with her sharp shuttle in her palm

facts.fact: Elise 断定 Isen 本想在他们抵达前破城，所以才用了那么酷烈的手段
facts.anchor: Isen had fully intended to have the siege broken before they arrived

facts.fact: Tilde 抓住她的手腕发抖，Elise 才想起王后比自己还年轻，一生都在战争的另一边
facts.anchor: the queen was even younger than she

facts.fact: Elise 推算航程与月份，认定 Alar 此行不可能只为向新后道贺
facts.anchor: he had been banished from Merogia for a decade

facts.fact: 「swanning」是把肺取出架在肩上如双翼的酷刑，曾被施于 Widdin 之王
facts.anchor: his lungs were cracked out and laid on his shoulders as wings

facts.fact: Elise 报出内堡存粮可撑数周而非数月，说明是母亲教她安排仓廪，声音却越说越小
Liran 命 Merovin 护送 Tilde 去营地，定下次日黎明试行谈判
facts.anchor: At dawn, we will try this parley
